# Chucksi Developers

Connect AI assistants and agents to Chucksi via MCP or REST. Public discovery is live: studio tools, effect/camera presets and workflow recipes. Remote generation, uploads, private projects and publishing are not connected. No account/key required for public discovery.

- Capabilities: https://console.chucksi.com/api/v1/capabilities
- Tools: https://console.chucksi.com/api/v1/tools
- Presets: https://console.chucksi.com/api/v1/presets
- Workflows: https://console.chucksi.com/api/v1/workflows
- OpenAPI: https://console.chucksi.com/api/v1/openapi.json
- MCP (Streamable HTTP): https://console.chucksi.com/mcp
- Website templates: https://chucksi.com/website/templates/

- [Connect your AI to Chucksi](https://console.chucksi.com/docs/quick-start/): Give an assistant access to Chucksi’s public tools, presets and workflow recipes.
- [Connect with MCP](https://console.chucksi.com/docs/connect-mcp/): Let a compatible assistant discover Chucksi tools and prepare a studio workflow.
- [Chucksi API reference](https://console.chucksi.com/docs/api-reference/): Connect your application to the same tools and recipes used by Chucksi.
- [Work with effects & camera presets](https://console.chucksi.com/docs/presets/): Find the exact recipe behind a Chucksi effect.
- [Connect tools into workflows](https://console.chucksi.com/docs/workflows/): Help an agent choose the steps from an idea to a finished project.
- [Access, limits & troubleshooting](https://console.chucksi.com/docs/troubleshooting/): Understand the connection and resolve common errors.
